title: zanity.toml
description: Settings for zanity check: which rules run, which files are skipped, and how --infer asks TypeSafe.

rules.description: Run only these rules instead of the defaults. "all" is every rule, including those off by default. --rules on the command line overrides it.

disable.description: Rules to leave out of the selection, such as ["duplicate-name"].

exclude.description: Paths to skip, in .gitignore syntax, relative to this file, such as ["vendor/", "tests/fixtures/**"].

infer.description: How check --infer asks TypeSafe about error messages.

concurrency.description: Requests sent to TypeSafe at once.

threshold.description: How sure TypeSafe must be for a judgement to become a finding: 0.9 reports only what it is at least 90% sure of, and a lower value reports more.

paths.description: Rules that don't report in some files, one table per pattern, such as [paths."tests/e2e/"]. Patterns are .gitignore syntax, relative to this file.

disable.description: Rules that don't report in the files this pattern matches.

anyOf.description: Every rule, including those off by default.
